custodyProfile.uncertainty: The whitepaper states the ISC Reserves maintain full possession and ownership of the assets, and the dashboard API names two reserves with ETF and cash figures, but the specific custodians, legal entities, account segregation, insolvency treatment, and rehypothecation terms are not disclosed. Source correction researched 2026-10-20: the prior reserve composition counted the API's holdings.ISC column as self-held backing, although the issuer's dashboard implementation labels it ISC Liability. All prior percentages used that liability in the asset denominator and are withdrawn, rather than renormalized into a new undated portfolio. The reserve API supplies no holdings timestamp or report period, and the displayed Last update is generated from the browser date; no current source-dated replacement composition or completed independent audit was retrieved. Original custody review start is retained; this correction establishes neither missing custody protections nor their absence.
